description:
An exceptional opportunity awaits a dedicated and experienced Licensed Nursing Home Administrator (LNHA) to lead a premier skilled nursing facility in Baltimore County, MD. This confidential role offers a chance to make a significant impact on resident care and operational excellence within a supportive environment.

As the LNHA, you will be responsible for the overall management and strategic direction of the facility, ensuring compliance with all regulatory standards and fostering a culture of compassion and quality. Your leadership will be crucial in overseeing daily operations, financial performance, and the delivery of high-quality patient care.

We are seeking a visionary leader with a passion for long-term care. This role offers a competitive salary range of $115,000 - $145,000 per year, commensurate with experience. Join a team committed to providing outstanding care and a positive environment for both residents and staff.
requirements: Active and unencumbered Licensed Nursing Home Administrator (LNHA) license in the state of Maryland.
Minimum of 3-5 years of experience as an LNHA or in a similar leadership role within a skilled nursing facility.
Comprehensive knowledge of state and federal regulations (e.g., CMS, OBRA) pertaining to long-term care.
Demonstrated ability to manage facility operations, financial performance, and staff development effectively.
Strong leadership, communication, and interpersonal skills.
salaryOrBonusInfo: Compensation: $115,000 - $145,000 per year, based on experience.

description: We are seeking a dedicated and experienced MDS Coordinator (RN) to join a premier skilled nursing facility in Missouri Valley, IA. This full-time position offers a competitive salary range of $65,000 - $75,000 per year, reflecting your expertise and commitment to quality patient care. We are looking for a permanent team member to contribute to our mission of providing exceptional health and rehabilitation services.As an MDS Coordinator, you will play a crucial role in the resident assessment process, ensuring accurate and timely completion of the Minimum Data Set (MDS). Your responsibilities will include coordinating care plans, collaborating with interdisciplinary teams, and maintaining compliance with all federal and state regulations. This is an excellent opportunity for an RN with a passion for comprehensive resident care and strong organizational skills to make a significant impact.
requirements: Active Registered Nurse (RN) license in Iowa or a compact state
Minimum of 1-2 years of experience as an MDS Coordinator in a skilled nursing facility
Proficient knowledge of the Resident Assessment Instrument (RAI) process and Medicare/Medicaid regulations
Strong assessment, documentation, and communication skills

description: We are seeking a dedicated and experienced Assistant Director of Nursing (ADON) to join a premier rehabilitation center in Frostburg, MD. This leadership role offers a significant opportunity to contribute to patient care excellence and operational efficiency within a supportive environment. The ideal candidate will play a crucial part in overseeing nursing operations and ensuring the highest standards of quality care.As an ADON, you will work closely with the Director of Nursing to manage daily clinical activities, supervise nursing staff, and implement patient care policies. This position is perfect for an RN with proven leadership skills looking to advance their career in a dynamic rehabilitation setting. Compensation for this vital role is competitive, with an annual salary ranging from $75,000 to $90,000, based on experience and qualifications.
requirements: Minimum of 2 years of experience in a leadership or supervisory nursing role
Clinical experience in a rehabilitation or skilled nursing facility setting
Strong understanding of nursing best practices and regulatory compliance
salaryOrBonusInfo: Annual salary range of $75,000 - $90,000, commensurate with experience.
